question:
SITE DESIGN QUESTION from the owner of PaperTrades.AI. NOT a trading turn. Majority wins; Claude voted first in a separate file (attached).

The owner: "Add more options than just Most relevant. Do a drop-down box rather than a single check: highest profits All in, highest profits, biggest losses, that kind of idea. Work with Gemini and GPT to complete."

TODAY: the Race standings panel (right side of the home page) has a race menu (Overall, the ten races, the two All in side races) and under it ONE checkbox: "Most relevant: follow the market that's live right now" (on at every visit; it auto-picks the race whose market is open or moving most, re-checked at each data update, with a "Why this one" note). Unticking it jumps to Overall.

PROPOSAL (vote AGREE / DISAGREE / AMEND each, one line why):
D1. Replace the checkbox with a drop-down labelled "Auto-pick:" under the race menu. Each option picks the race automatically and re-checks at every data update; a one-line note says why that race was picked (e.g. "Gemini is +C$22,842 in Options, the biggest profit in any race").
D2. Options, in this order:
  1. Most relevant: the market that's live right now (default at every visit, today's behaviour)
  2. Biggest profit: the race where any AI is furthest ahead of its C$100,000 start (ten races)
  3. Biggest loss: the race where any AI is furthest behind (ten races)
  4. Closest race: the smallest gap between 1st and 2nd (ten races)
  5. Biggest lead: the largest gap between 1st and 2nd (ten races)
  6. Biggest profit (All in side race): All in: trading or All in: sports, whichever has the bigger profit
  7. Biggest loss (All in side race)
  8. Off: I'll choose (goes to Overall, today's "untick" behaviour)
D3. Picking a race yourself in the race menu sets Auto-pick to "Off".
D4. Profits compare in C$ (China converted); the note names the AI and the amount.
D5. The choice is kept while the page is open but not remembered between visits (every visit starts on Most relevant).

Reply as JSON: {"D1": "AGREE|DISAGREE|AMEND: why", ..., "D5": "...", "other": "anything missing (optional)"}

chatgpt.answer:
{
  "D1": "AGREE: a drop-down is the right control once there are multiple auto-pick modes, and keeping the one-line reason makes the automatic choice understandable.",
  "D2": "AGREE: the list covers relevance, profit, loss, competitiveness, dominance, All in side races, and an explicit Off state.",
  "D3": "AGREE: a manual race selection should mean the user has taken control, so auto-pick should stop moving the panel.",
  "D4": "AGREE: comparing everything in C$ is fair and naming the AI plus amount makes the pick transparent.",
  "D5": "AGREE: keeping it only for the open page preserves user intent during a session while making every new visit start with the live-market default.",
  "other": "Add a simple tie-break rule for equal picks, such as prefer the race already selected, then Most relevant, then the race menu order."
}
